checks: Canonical UUID/Job-number lookup and ambiguous exact names preserve all candidates
Bounded result pagination has stable disjoint pages; archives require explicit inclusion
Exact controlled fixture UUID is excluded from defaults/overview and requires manageUsers for explicit lookup
Summary counts only recorded unresolved follow-ups and preserves original versus active Rework lifecycle
Missing Job facts remain null; released-disabled Planning never queries phase/item records or invents progress
Labor uses integer hundredths, inclusive Chicago dates, canonical UUID and explicit Rework attribution; unlinked/other/out-of-period rows are excluded
Overview reuses effective lifecycle, exact status/schedule counts and a bounded upcoming list
Real authenticated PostgreSQL RLS hides the scoped Job across lookup/summary/planning/labor
Inactive/revoked memberships fail before record reads on every request; permitted read-only Guest can read
Partial tools retain safe verified Job facts, unavailable labor invents no totals, and incomplete transport invalidates exact aggregates
Final capability and scoped-row revocation discard previously fetched facts; malformed null labor suppresses totals and a hanging transport obeys the shared abort deadline
Strict arguments/search escaping and the fixture bridge reject arbitrary SQL, extra projections, private tables and finance/body fields
All output carries units/time/source metadata and excludes stored finance/notes/employee sentinels; existing TenBot records are unchanged
Handler validates synthetic explanation against real tool facts and retains canonical lookup context without live prose
Same-owner Job follow-up executes fresh tools; incorrect quantitative prose and provider outage return verified deterministic facts
Handler leaves ambiguous names unselected; another authorized account cannot reuse owner context or replay caller history
Refresh/follow-up reauthorize after scoped RLS revocation; in-flight grant loss prevents old model facts from publishing
Service authority is limited to owner context/metering; prior feedback/history/usage/conversation rows stay intact, with no private history in operational model input
scope: Five read-only Job tools with real local PostgreSQL capability and row authorization; deliberately incomplete transport cases are identified separately.
limitations: SET ROLE/JWT-sub fixture is not hosted HTTP Auth transport
No live Production records or hosted query plans inspected
